about: ACE-Step 1.5 cue spec. tools/music_pipeline.py turns each (cue, seed) into a studio run of acestep15-cue.json, analyses the candidates, picks one per cue, trims it to an exact bar multiple at 120 BPM, builds the loop seam and encodes web/audio/music/. All music is original; prompts never name an existing game, composer or soundtrack.
common_tags: instrumental, no vocals, original video game soundtrack, 120 bpm, 4/4, steady tempo, seamless loop

kinds.loop: whole file loops; start on a downbeat, length = beats exactly; the first crossfade_s blend the continuation bar into the start so the wrap is continuous
kinds.tail: plays `beats` once, then the appended copy of its last bar loops (loopStart..loopEnd) until the next cue
kinds.oneshot: plays `beats` once and ends with a fade over `fade_s`
